newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says recent forex moves excessive.
newsitem.headline: MOF says recent forex moves excessive.

text.p: Recent movements in the foreign exchange market have been excessive and Japan will take appropriate measures in a timely manner, Vice Finance Minister Tadashi Ogawa said on Thursday.
"Recent movements of the yen in the exchange markets have been clearly excessive. We will take decisive action against these moves in a timely manner," Ogawa told a regular news conference.
Asked whether Japan and the United States shared the same view on currencies, Ogawa said: "We are of course keeping in close contact with U.S. authorities."
Ogawa said he did not want to comment on details.
